$comment: The single allow-list, read by scripts/check-licenses.mjs (npm + the bundled wasm components in third-party.json) and scripts/check-licenses-rust.mjs (crates compiled into the desktop binary). Policy and reasoning live in docs/LICENSE-POLICY.md; a new entry here needs an ADR.

notes.IJG: Bundled binaries only: libjpeg-turbo, linked into qpdf.wasm. Accepted by ADR 0003 on 2026-10-16.
notes.Unicode-3.0: The ICU crates (icu_collections, icu_normalizer, icu_properties and siblings) that Tauri pulls in transitively. Permissive and attribution-only. Accepted by ADR 0005 on 2026-10-16.
notes.MIT-0: MIT with the attribution clause removed; strictly more permissive than MIT.
